directory.description: The directory to generate migrations in.

storage_parameters.description: The storage parameters for the partitions.

fillfactor.description: The fillfactor for a table is a percentage between 10 and 100. 100 (complete packing) is the default.

toast_tuple_target.description: Specifies the minimum tuple length required before we try to compress and/or move long column values into TOAST tables, and is also the target length we try to reduce the length below once toasting begins.

parallel_workers.description: This sets the number of workers that should be used to assist a parallel scan of a table.

autovacuum_enabled.description: Enables or disables the autovacuum daemon for a table.

vacuum_index_cleanup.description: Enables or disables index cleanup when VACUUM is run on a table.

vacuum_truncate.description: Enables or disables vacuum to try to truncate off any empty pages at the end of a table.

autovacuum_vacuum_threshold.description: Specifies the minimum number of updated or deleted tuples needed to trigger a VACUUM in a table.

autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor.description: Specifies a fraction of a table size to add to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold when deciding whether to trigger a VACUUM

autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold.description: Specifies the number of inserted tuples needed to trigger a VACUUM in a table.

autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor.description: Specifies a fraction of a table size to add to autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold when deciding whether to trigger a VACUUM.

autovacuum_analyze_threshold.description: Specifies the minimum number of inserted, updated or deleted tuples needed to trigger an ANALYZE in a table.

autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor.description: Specifies a fraction of a table size to add to autovacuum_analyze_threshold when deciding whether to trigger an ANALYZE.

autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay.description: Specifies the cost delay value that will be used in automatic VACUUM operations.

autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit.description: Specifies the cost limit value that will be used in automatic VACUUM operations.

autovacuum_freeze_min_age.description: Specifies the cutoff age (in transactions) that VACUUM should use to decide whether to freeze row versions while scanning a table.

autovacuum_freeze_max_age.description: Specifies the maximum age (in transactions) that a table's pg_class.relfrozenxid field can attain before a VACUUM operation is forced to prevent transaction ID wraparound within a table.

autovacuum_freeze_table_age.description: VACUUM performs an aggressive scan if a table's pg_class.relfrozenxid field has reached the age specified by this setting.

autovacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age.description: Specifies the cutoff age (in multixacts) that VACUUM should use to decide whether to replace multixact IDs with a newer transaction ID or multixact ID while scanning a table.

autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age.description: Specifies the maximum age (in multixacts) that a table's pg_class.relminmxid field can attain before a VACUUM operation is forced to prevent multixact ID wraparound within a table.

autovacuum_multixact_freeze_table_age.description: VACUUM performs an aggressive scan if a table's pg_class.relminmxid field has reached the age specified by this setting.

log_autovacuum_min_duration.description: Causes each action executed by autovacuum to be logged if it ran for at least the specified amount of time. Setting this to zero logs all autovacuum actions

user_catalog_table.description: Declare a table as an additional catalog table for purposes of logical replication

name_template.description: The name template for the partitions.

past.description: The number of past partitions to generate.

future.description: The number of future partitions to generate.

default_partition_name_template.description: The name template for the default partition.

retention.description: The retention time interval to expire partitions containing data older than the given interval.

detach_first.description: Whether to detach the expired partitions first before dropping them.

detach_only.description: Whether to only detach the expired partitions.

detach_concurrently.description: Whether to detach the expired partitions concurrently.

timezone.description: The timezone to use for the generation of the migration files.

tables.description: List of tables to generate partitions for.

items.description: The table to generate partitions for.

file_name_template.description: The template for the migration filename.

make.description: The description for generation of partitions.

expire.description: The description for expiration of partitions.

partition.description: The partition configuration for a table.
